name: Bullet Style Demo
summary:
This is a demo with limited content and functionality. Please purchase the full version of the game to gain access to all current and future content.

Welcome to Bullet Style! An all-new roomscale virtual reality shooter that immerses players in action-packed gunfights using real movement. Become the action hero of your dreams and experience intense combat by navigating seemingly endless levels with your own two feet.
